title: THE FORGE: EXTRACT IT AND YOU KEEP IT
why: His rule of 2026-10-12: if you extract with an upgraded gun you get to keep it. In CAREER, a forged gun you carry out (in your hands or in the backpack) now keeps its MK and element on that gun model in your armoury, and comes up forged on your next deploy. If you already owned a plain one, your armoury gun becomes the upgraded one, and an extracted upgrade never makes a better one worse. Dying with it loses it with the gun, as always (coming back empty). Abandoning puts your armoury back as it was, so an older upgrade survives and one bought that raid is not kept. A broken saved record is dropped when the save loads. DEMO has no stash, so nothing is kept there.
now: In CAREER an upgraded gun you extract with stays upgraded in your armoury.
